keywords = []
_lands_you_control = Selector(
    QUnbounded(), SelectorMode.ALL,
    FAnd(children=(
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
        FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
    )),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
abilities = [
    # [0] This land enters tapped.
    EtBState(tapped=True),
    # [1] {T}: Add {C}.
    compiled[1],
    # [2] Whenever this land or another land you control enters, if you control seven or more lands
    # with different names, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
    TriggeredAbility(
        event=ZoneChangeEvent(
            from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
            to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            subject=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
            )),
        ),
        condition=at_least(7, quantity=QDistinct(_lands_you_control, QPropField.NAME)),
        effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
            'count': QConst(value=1),
            'tokens': TokenSpec(
                name='Zombie', type_line='Creature — Zombie', types=('Creature',),
                subtypes=('Zombie',), power=QConst(value=2), toughness=QConst(value=2),
                keywords=(), abilities=(), colors=('B',),
            ),
        }),
    ),
]
